body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy adjacent to an empty landing space within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Leap to the landing space along a clear path. On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage to the target.

surges.html: On a hit, push the target 2 units away from your landing space.

rider.title: Adaptation - Strider
rider.html: Assume Pneumatics (upkeep 0): your jumps ignore the first 1 unit of vertical rise, but cannot pass through solid obstacles or end unsupported.
